verdict.rationale: This is a fair question for a password manager with business use, since such products can plausibly offer push-based login approvals and admin-enforced MFA policies, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of push-based sign-in, number matching, location context, or admin-enforced MFA policies. The closest items are TOTP code generation, 2FA reminders and Proton Sentinel account protection, and none of these is push-based phishing-resistant sign-in.
